answer:
Guideline-directed medical therapy for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) per the **AHA/ACC/HFSA 2022 Guideline** includes:  
- **ARNI/ACEi/ARB** (angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitors/angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors/angiotensin receptor blockers)  
- **Beta-blockers**  
- **Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists** (MRAs)  
- **SGLT2 inhibitors** (recommended regardless of diabetes status)  

These therapies are foundational for improving outcomes in HFrEF. Always review guidelines for individual patient adaptation [AHA/ACC/HFSA, 2022](https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/CIR.0000000000001063).
